# Modal

Native dialog: centered card on desktop, bottom sheet on small screens, scrim via token.

Category: overlay · Behavior: js-inline · Schema: 2.0.0 · Source: original

Ships a dependency-free script; wire its hooks to your own state as needed.

## Variants

No variant table; the item has a single form.

## Slots

Named `[data-uifa-slot]` render positions; the root is the implicit default slot.

- `open` - Trigger that opens the dialog.
- `title` - Dialog heading.
- `body` - Dialog copy.
- `actions` - Footer action cluster.
- `cancel` - Dismiss action.
- `confirm` - Primary action; danger styling for destructive flows.

## Tokens

Reads: `--uifa-surface`, `--uifa-border`, `--uifa-border-strong`, `--uifa-border-width`, `--uifa-text`, `--uifa-text-muted`, `--uifa-accent`, `--uifa-accent-fg`, `--uifa-accent-soft`, `--uifa-danger`, `--uifa-danger-fg`, `--uifa-scrim`, `--uifa-radius-control`, `--uifa-shadow-char`, `--uifa-font-display`, `--uifa-font-body`, `--uifa-text-base`, `--uifa-space`, `--uifa-duration`, `--uifa-ease`. Every color comes from a semantic role; nothing is hard-coded.

## Markup

```html
<!-- Native <dialog>: showModal() gives focus trap, Esc, and scrim for free. -->
<button type="button" class="uifa-modal-trigger" data-uifa-slot="open">Open modal</button>
<dialog class="uifa-modal" aria-label="Title">
  <h2 data-uifa-slot="title">Title</h2>
  <p data-uifa-slot="body">Body text.</p>
  <div data-uifa-slot="actions">
    <button type="button" class="uifa-modal-action" data-uifa-variant="secondary" data-uifa-slot="cancel">Cancel</button>
    <button type="button" class="uifa-modal-action" data-uifa-variant="danger" data-uifa-slot="confirm">Confirm</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

## Usage

Built on the native `<dialog>`: `showModal()` provides the focus trap, Esc to close, and the top layer; `::backdrop` reads `--uifa-scrim`. Confirm actions use `data-uifa-variant="danger"` for destructive flows. Below 480px the card docks to a bottom sheet.
